content: अणु {%a.%} (णु-ण्वी|{%f.%}) [अण्-उन्] Minute, small, little, atomic (<ab>opp.</ab> स्थूल, महत्); अणोरणीयान् <ls>Bg. 8. 9</ls>; सर्वोप्ययं नन्वणुः <ls>Bh. 3. 26</ls> insignificantly small; अण्वपि भयम् <ls>MS. 6. 40</ls>; अण्वपि याच्यमानः <ls>Pt. 4. 26</ls> asked but an atom, a very small quantity, न कन्यायाः पिता विद्वान् गृह्णीयात् शुल्कमण्वपि <ls>Ms. 3. 51</ls>. .{@-णुः@} .²1 An atom, a very small particle (an exceedingly small measure); the mote in a sunbeam, the smallest perceptible quantity; अस्थूलमनण्वह्नण्वमदीर्घं ब्रह्म; अणुं पर्वतीकृ <ls>Bh. 2. 78</ls> to magnify; <ab>cf.</ab> also ‘To make mountains of mole-hills’. .²2 An atom of time (व्यञ्जनमर्धमात्रा तदर्धम् अणु); it is said to be 54,675,000th part of a Muhūrta (48 minutes). .²3 <ab>N.</ab> of Śiva. .²4 <ab>N.</ab> of very small grain such as सर्षप, चीनक <ab>&c.</ab>, अनणुषु दशमांशोऽणुष्वथैकादशांशः <ls>Līlā.</ls> .{@-णु@} {%n.%} the fourth part of a Mātrā.
